---
title: "PyBoolnet"
---

`pyboolnet` is a Python toolbox for building, changing, and analyzing Boolean networks. It works from a prime-implicant representation and covers common tasks such as interaction graphs, state-transition graphs, attractors and basins, trap spaces, model checking, and graph drawing.

* <https://github.com/hklarner/pyboolnet>
